title: You, Writing! A Guide to College Composition - 3rd Edition
description: This text is meant to be used in any first year College Composition class or as a general guide to college writing. The book focuses on writing as a process, not a product. The goal is to help students discover their own writing process, trying out different methods and strategies to find what works best for them.
authors: Kelli Hallsten-Erickson - Author / Amy Jo Swing - Author
